This question was well answered in part (a) but less well in part (b).
(a) The vast majority of candidates gained at least one mark on this part on backups. This was usually
for the point that it is a copy of files. Some struggled to elaborate further.
(b) There were a large number of responses where candidates wrote about discs and tapes without

tape systems are updated and the ease of editing data.

seem to understand either of the two terms.
